trigger: Only when the task deliverable is a scientific report, manuscript, code-visible statistical report, or formatted PDF/HTML research artifact.

stages.rule: Source/claim and study data provenance reviewed independently of typography
Hypotheses, estimands, uncertainty, numeric fidelity, and limitations checked
Impersonal scientific prose, APA-aware notation, citation consistency and house style checked
Structural source screen with explicit command and observed result
Actual statistical execution with authorized data or explicitly BLOCKED
Output knitted from exact current source revision or explicitly BLOCKED
All final rendered pages inspected for presentation defects or explicitly BLOCKED
Evidence packet passed to orchestrator and independent release reviewer; no self-approval

release_interlock.pass_condition: E1-E8 PASS with linked verifiable evidence and exact source SHA; output artifact SHA-256 required for E6-E8
release_interlock.human_approval: Required separately for external publication or release
release_interlock.software_release_graph: unchanged; this is an opt-in specialized branch
